4 احراهُ It (time) caused it (a thing, S) to decrease, diminish, or wane. (S, K.) ＝
-A2- مَا أَحْرَاهُ, and أَحْرِ بِهِ, How well adapted or disposed, or how apt, meet, suited, suitable, fitted, fit, competent, or proper, or how worthy, is he! (S, K.) [You say, مَا أَحْرَاهُ بِذٰلِكَ How well adapted or disposed, &c., is he for that!]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
